description: This file contains formatting utility functions for CLI output related to sandbox status, along with some TypeScript type definitions and utility functions for counting running containers and mismatches.

methods.name: export function formatStatus(running: boolean): string { formatStatus
methods.description: Formats a boolean running status into a colored emoji status string.

methods.name: export function formatSimpleStatus(running: boolean): string { formatSimpleStatus
methods.description: Formats a boolean running status into a simple string ('running' or 'stopped').

methods.name: export function formatImageMatch(matches: boolean): string { formatImageMatch
methods.description: Formats a boolean image match status into a symbol string.

methods.name: export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of items with `running` set to true.

methods.name: export function countMismatches<T extends { imageMatch: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countMismatches
methods.description: Counts the number of items where `imageMatch` is false.

ctags.name: countMismatches
ctags.pattern: /^export function countMismatches<T extends { imageMatch: boolean }>(items: T[]): number {$/

ctags.name: countRunning
ctags.pattern: /^export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number {$/
